## Prefill–decode disaggregation and elasticity

| Year / venue | Work / artifact | Code | Reading role | Contribution and scope |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026 / arXiv | <a name="fluidpd"></a>[FluidPD: In-Place Elasticity for SLO-Aware Prefill-Decode Disaggregated LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06917)<br>paper | — | adjacent | Combines bounded prefill offload with in-place worker role reassignment to address transient and sustained imbalance.<br>**Scope:** Recent preprint; compare adaptation overhead, decode SLO protection, and workload sensitivity before generalizing. |
| 2025 / arXiv | <a name="dynaserve"></a>[DynaServe: Unified and Elastic Execution for Dynamic Disaggregated LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.09285)<br>paper | — | adjacent | Uses lead/follow GPU execution to adapt between colocated and disaggregated processing under changing demand.<br>**Scope:** Tandem execution differs from a strict fixed prefill-only/decode-only split; compare policies on equal resources. |
| 2025 / arXiv | <a name="multi-vendor-pd"></a>[Disaggregated Prefill and Decoding Inference System for Large Language Model Serving on Multi-Vendor GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.17542)<br>paper | — | adjacent | Studies compatible KV transmission and joint parallelism/instance allocation across different GPU vendors.<br>**Scope:** Vendor-specific transport compatibility and deployment assumptions must be checked for each device pair. |
| 2024 / OSDI | <a name="distserve"></a>[DistServe: Disaggregating Prefill and Decoding for Goodput-optimized Large Language Model Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.09670)<br>paper | [Code](https://github.com/LLMServe/DistServe) | foundational | Canonical PD-disaggregation system and one of the clearest TTFT/TPOT goodput framings.<br>**Scope:** Mostly studies phase split; operator-level AFD is outside scope. |
| 2024 / SOSP | <a name="loongserve"></a>[LoongServe: Efficiently Serving Long-Context Large Language Models with Elastic Sequence Parallelism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.09526)<br>paper | [Code](https://github.com/LoongServe/LoongServe) | substrate | Shows long-context serving stresses static placement and motivates elastic execution.<br>**Scope:** Sequence-parallel long-context serving is adjacent to, not identical with, AFD. |
| 2024 / arXiv | <a name="pdserve"></a>[P/D-Serve: Serving Disaggregated Large Language Model at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.08147)<br>paper | — | production | Studies practical issues in scaling PD-disaggregated serving.<br>**Scope:** Does not address attention/FFN operator disaggregation. |
| 2024 / ISCA | <a name="splitwise"></a>[Splitwise: Efficient Generative LLM Inference Using Phase Splitting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.18677)<br>paper | — | foundational | Early and influential argument for serving prefill and decode on different hardware tiers.<br>**Scope:** Static phase-splitting model does not cover newer AFD/MoE operator splits. |
| 2024 / arXiv | <a name="tetriinfer"></a>[Inference without Interference: Disaggregate LLM Inference for Mixed Downstream Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.11181)<br>paper | — | adjacent | Studies interference between heterogeneous inference workloads under disaggregated serving.<br>**Scope:** Less central than DistServe and Splitwise for the AFD line. |

The linked runtime contains an implementation; follow its version-specific feature guide. |

| 2025 / arXiv | <a name="lmcache"></a>[LMCache: An Efficient KV Cache Layer for Enterprise-Scale LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.09665)<br>paper | [Code](https://github.com/LMCache/LMCache) | substrate | Makes cache reuse a reusable serving layer.<br>**Scope:** AFD integration remains an open design question. |
